title: Api client localStorage access is not SSR-safe

evidence.quote: setToken and getToken unconditionally access localStorage.
request() always calls getToken() before fetch.

reasoning: SvelteKit code can execute during server-side rendering or prerendering, where localStorage is undefined. Any API helper that calls getToken(), including request() and isAuthenticated(), will throw a ReferenceError if invoked outside the browser, turning otherwise valid rendering or checks into runtime failures.
reproduction: Run the module in a Node/SvelteKit SSR context where globalThis.localStorage is undefined and call api.isAuthenticated() or any request-backed method; it throws before making the request.
recommendation: Guard browser-only storage access with SvelteKit's browser flag or a typeof localStorage check. Return the in-memory token only when storage is unavailable, and avoid touching localStorage outside the browser.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests exercise importing or calling the API client in a non-browser environment.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Node-environment unit test that deletes/mocks out globalThis.localStorage, imports the API client, and verifies api.isAuthenticated() and api.setToken(null) do not throw.
minimumFixScope: Change setToken() and getToken() in frontend/src/lib/api/client.ts to handle non-browser environments safely.
